Partner contribution is required under the standard funding model, so requires_match_funding is TRUE.

Streams include disaster risk reduction-climate adaptation, emergency operations centres, emergency support services, flood risk assessment/mapping/mitigation planning, evacuation route planning, structural flood mitigation, and volunteer/composite fire departments. Academic teams should treat this as a partner-led BC implementation pathway, not a university-led research grant.

Official UBCM page says CRI was announced by the BC government in 2018 to reduce wildfire risk and mitigate impacts on BC communities. Streams include FireSmart Community Funding and Supports, Crown Land Wildfire Risk Reduction, and a FireSmart pilot for regional district cooperative community wildfire response organizations. Academic teams should treat this as a BC community/First Nation/local-government implementation pathway that can pair with research evidence or decision-support tools.
